note: Fixed, generic planning briefs for scoring how well a coordinator plans. They name no product. Each brief says what a good plan must contain; the scorer checks the plan, not the model.

briefs.title: Add a paid checkout to a web app
briefs.brief: Our hosted web app lets people read stories for free. Add a way for readers to pay a monthly subscription with a card, see their plan, and cancel. Use an existing payment provider. The app has a database and a test suite.

briefs.title: Rename a database column safely
briefs.brief: A column in a large table is badly named and used across the codebase. Rename it with no downtime and a way back. The service is live and has no staging environment.

briefs.title: Ship a new version of a desktop app
briefs.brief: Our desktop app is installed on users' own computers and updates itself from public releases. Prepare and publish version 2.1 with a changelog, a signed package and a safe update path.

briefs.title: Harden sign-in
briefs.brief: Review and strengthen how people sign in and reset passwords on our web app: rate limits, session expiry, and reset token handling. Fix what you find.

briefs.title: Write a how-to guide
briefs.brief: Write a short how-to guide for a feature that already exists: connecting the app to a calendar. Include screenshots placeholders and a troubleshooting section.

briefs.title: Find why a test fails sometimes
briefs.brief: One test in our suite fails about one run in twenty. Find the cause and fix it without deleting the test.

briefs.title: Upgrade a major dependency
briefs.brief: Upgrade the web framework our app depends on by one major version. Keep the app working, keep the tests passing, and keep a way back.

briefs.title: Add a usage report page
briefs.brief: Add a page that shows each team's weekly usage as a chart and a table, read-only, computed from data we already store.
